Sovollar: 1. Are you a happy person?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz baxtli insonmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I consider myself a truly happy person. I always try to maintain an optimistic mindset, appreciate what I have in life, and spend meaningful time with my family and supportive friends.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men o‘zimni chinakam baxtli inson deb bilaman. Men doimo nekbin (ijobiy) fikrlashga, hayotda bor narsalarimni qadrlashga va oilam hamda qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi do‘stlarim bilan mazmunli vaqt o‘tkazishga harakat qilaman.

Sovollar: 2. When do you feel unhappy?
Sovollar (UZ): Qachon o‘zingizni baxtsiz his qilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I usually feel unhappy when I encounter unexpected failures, face overwhelming stress, or when I see my loved ones struggling with difficult situations and illnesses.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men odatda kutilmagan muvaffaqiyatsizliklarga duch kelganimda, og‘ir stress holatida qolganimda yoki yaqinlarimning qiyin vaziyatlar va kasalliklar bilan kurashayotganini ko‘rganimda o‘zimni baxtsiz his qilaman.

Sovollar: 3. What makes you happy?
Sovollar (UZ): Sizni nima baxtli qiladi?
FullAnswer_EN: Accomplishing my personal goals, helping people in need, travelling to new destinations, and having heartfelt conversations with my close friends bring immense joy to my life.
FullAnswer_UZ: Shaxsiy maqsadlarimga erishish, muhtoj insonlarga yordam berish, yangi joylarga sayohat qilish va yaqin do‘stlarim bilan samimiy suhbatlar qurish hayotimga cheksiz quvonch bag‘ishlaydi.

Sovollar: 4. Are you introvert or extravert?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz introvertmisiz yoki ekstravert?
FullAnswer_EN: I would say I am an ambivert. While I thoroughly enjoy socializing with people and collaborating in teams, I also need regular quiet moments alone to recharge my mental energy.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men o‘zimni ambivert (ikkala xususiyatga ega inson) deb aytgan bo‘lardim. Men insonlar bilan muloqot qilishni va jamoada ishlashni yoqtirsam-da, ruhiy quvvatimni tiklash uchun yolg‘iz sokin daqiqalarga ham muhtojman.

Sovollar: 1. Are kids patient nowadays? What things can’t they wait for?
Sovollar (UZ): Hozirgi bolalar sabrlimi? Ular nimalarni kuta olishmaydi?
FullAnswer_EN: Generally speaking, modern children are less patient due to instant digital technology. They constantly expect immediate results, especially when downloading mobile games, receiving fast food, or waiting for their parents to buy them new gadgets.
FullAnswer_UZ: Umuman olganda, zamonaviy bolalar tezkor raqamli texnologiyalar sababli sabrsizroqdir. Ular doimo tezkor natijalarni kutishadi, ayniqsa mobil o‘yinlarni yuklab olishda, tez tayyor bo‘ladigan taomlarni olishda yoki ota-onalaridan yangi gadjetlar sotib berishni kutishda.

Sovollar: 2. Should parents buy their kids whatever they want?
Sovollar (UZ): Ota-onalar farzandlariga ular xohlagan hamma narsani sotib berishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: No, absolutely not. Buying everything spoils children and prevents them from understanding the true value of hard-earned money and patience. Parents should teach them discipline and prioritize real necessities over impulse wishes.
FullAnswer_UZ: Yo‘q, aslo unday emas. Hamma narsani sotib berish bolalarni erkalatib yuboradi va ularga mehnat bilan topilgan pulning va sabrning haqiqiy qadrini tushunishga to‘sqinlik qiladi. Ota-onalar ularga tartib-intizomni o‘rgatishlari va injiqliklardan ko‘ra haqiqiy ehtiyojlarni ustun qo‘yishlari kerak.

Sovollar: 3. Do parents need to teach their children to be patient?
Sovollar (UZ): Ota-onalar farzandlariga sabrli bo‘lishni o‘rgatishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, definitely. Patience is an indispensable life skill that helps individuals overcome obstacles, make thoughtful long-term decisions, and build healthy relationships throughout their adult lives.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, albatta. Sabr-toqat — bu insonlarga qiyinchiliklarni yengishga, o‘ylab uzoq muddatli qarorlar qabul qilishga va butun ulg‘aygan hayotlari davomida sog‘lom munosabatlar o‘rnatishga yordam beradigan ajralmas hayotiy ko‘nikmadir.

Sovollar: 4. How do you manage to resist your temptation?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz vasvasa va vasvasaga tushishga qarshi qanday kurashasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I resist temptations by practicing self-control and focusing on my ultimate long-term objectives. For instance, when I feel tempted to waste time on social media, I remind myself of my academic priorities and immediately eliminate distractions.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men o‘z-o‘zimni nazorat qilishni mashq qilib, asosiy uzoq muddatli maqsadlarimga diqqatimni qaratish orqali vasvasalarni yengaman. Masalan, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda vaqtni behuda sarflash vasvasasi paydo bo‘lganda, o‘qishdagi ustuvor vazifalarimni eslayman va chalg‘ituvchi omillarni darhol bartaraf qilaman.

Sovollar: 1. Are you interested in doing business?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz biznes qilishga qiziqasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I am deeply interested in entrepreneurship because it offers financial independence, fosters creative innovation, and provides the opportunity to create valuable jobs for other people.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men tadbirkorlikka juda qiziqaman, chunki u moliyaviy mustaqillik beradi, ijodiy innovatsiyalarni rivojlantiradi va boshqa insonlar uchun qadrli ish o‘rinlarini yaratish imkoniyatini taqdim etadi.

Sovollar: 2. Is it easy to set up a business in Uzbekistan?
Sovollar (UZ): O‘zbekistonda biznes boshlash osonmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Recently, it has become significantly easier due to government reforms, digital tax services, and online registration portals, although securing substantial starting capital and finding skilled employees remain challenging.
FullAnswer_UZ: So‘nggi paytlarda hukumat islohotlari, raqamli soliq xizmatlari va onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tish portallari tufayli bu ancha osonlashdi, garchi yetarli boshlang‘ich kapital topish va malakali xodimlarni jalb qilish qiyinligicha qolmoqda.

Sovollar: 3. Do you have any business people in your family?
Sovollar (UZ): Oilangizda biznes bilan shug‘ullanuvchi insonlar bormi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, my uncle successfully runs a commercial trading company, and his determination, strategic thinking, and strong work ethic have always inspired my career aspirations.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, mening tog‘am tijorat savdo kompaniyasini muvaffaqiyatli boshqaradi va uning qat’iyati, strategik fikrlashi hamda kuchli mehnatsevarligi har doim mening kasbiy maqsadlarimga ilhom berib kelgan.

Sovollar: 4. What successful companies do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qanday muvaffaqiyatli kompaniyalarni bilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Globally, I admire tech giants like Apple, Google, and Amazon, while in Uzbekistan, innovative enterprises such as Korzinka, Payme, and Uzum have achieved remarkable market success.
FullAnswer_UZ: Dunyo miqyosida men Apple, Google va Amazon kabi texnologiya gigantlarini qadrlayman, O‘zbekistonda esa Korzinka, Payme va Uzum kabi innovatsion korxonalar ajoyib bozor muvaffaqiyatiga erishdi.

Sovollar: 1. If you wanted to set up a business, what business would you start?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar biznes boshlamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, qanday biznes boshlagan bo‘lardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I would launch an educational technology startup that provides affordable online courses and interactive English learning tools for students across remote regions of our country.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men mamlakatimizning chekka hududlaridagi talabalar uchun hamyonbop onlayn kurslar va interaktiv ingliz tili o‘rganish vositalarini taqdim etuvchi ta’lim texnologiyalari (EdTech) startapini ishga tushirgan bo‘lardim.

Sovollar: 2. What are the challenges of starting a business?
Sovollar (UZ): Biznes boshlashning qanday qiyinchiliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: The primary challenges include securing sufficient funding, managing financial risks, navigating fierce market competition, and attracting loyal, high-performing employees.
FullAnswer_UZ: Asosiy qiyinchiliklar qatoriga yetarli mablag‘ni jalb qilish, moliyaviy xatarlarni boshqarish, shiddatli bozor raqobatiga bardosh berish hamda sadoqatli, yuqori malakali xodimlarni jalb qilish kiradi.

Sovollar: 3. How can you advertise your products or service?
Sovollar (UZ): Mahsulot yoki xizmatingizni qanday reklama qila olasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: The most effective method today is digital marketing, including targeted social media campaigns on Instagram and Telegram, collaborating with credible influencers, and optimizing search engines.
FullAnswer_UZ: Bugungi kunda eng samarali usul bu raqamli marketingdir, jumladan Instagram va Telegramda maqsadli reklama kampaniyalari, ishonchli blogerlar bilan hamkorlik qilish va qidiruv tizimlarini optimallashtirish (SEO).

Sovollar: 4. If you needed some financial support, how would you attract some investors?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar sizga moliyaviy yordam kerak bo‘lsa, investorlarni qanday jalb qilgan bo‘lardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I would prepare a comprehensive business plan with clear financial projections, demonstrate a viable prototype, and present a compelling pitch highlighting the unique competitive edge of the project.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men aniq moliyaviy hisob-kitoblarga ega puxta biznes-rejani tayyorlagan, ishchi prototipni namoyish etgan va loyihaning o‘ziga xos raqobatdosh ustunligini ko‘rsatib beruvchi jozibador taqdimot (pitch) o‘tkazgan bo‘lardim.

Sovollar: 1. Do you like competitions?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz musobaqa va raqobatlarni yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I enjoy healthy competitions because they motivate me to push beyond my limits, stay fully focused, and continually refine my skills.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men sog‘lom raqobatni yoqtiraman, chunki u meni o‘z imkoniyatlarim chegarasidan chiqishga, to‘liq diqqatni jamlashga va ko‘nikmalarimni doimiy ravishda takomillashtirishga undaydi.

Sovollar: 2. Have you ever taken part in a competition?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz hech musobaqada qatnashganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, during my high school years, I took part in regional academic Olympiads and chess tournaments, which taught me great discipline and emotional resilience.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, maktab yillarimda men mintaqaviy fan olimpiadalari va shaxmat turnirlarida qatnashganman, bu menga kuchli intizom va ruhiy matonatni o‘rgatgan.

Sovollar: 3. Which is more important: competition or cooperation?
Sovollar (UZ): Qaysi biri muhimroq: raqobatmi yoki hamkorlik?
FullAnswer_EN: Both are crucial, but I believe cooperation is fundamentally more important because solving major global and community problems requires teamwork, empathy, and collective harmony.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ikkalasi ham juda muhim, ammo men hamkorlikni asosiy jihatdan muhimroq deb hisoblayman, chunki katta global va jamiyat muammolarini hal qilish jamoaviy ish, empatiya va o‘zaro hamjihatlikni talab qiladi.

Sovollar: 4. Do you like competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz raqobatli sport turlarini yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I am a passionate fan of competitive sports like football and boxing because the intense spirit, strategic gameplay, and unpredictable drama are truly thrilling.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men futbol va boks kabi raqobatli sport turlarining ashaddiy muxlisiman, chunki ulardagi shiddatli ruh, strategik o‘yin va oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan qiziqarli lahzalar chinakam hayajon bag‘ishlaydi.

Sovollar: 1. What competitive sports do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qanday raqobatli sport turlarini bilasiz?

FullAnswer_UZ: Men futbol, basketbol va voleybol kabi jamoaviy o‘yinlardan tortib, tennis, suzish va yakkakurash san’atlari kabi individual sport turlarigacha bo‘lgan ko‘plab raqobatli sportlarni bilaman.

Sovollar: 2. Should children do competitive sports at school?
Sovollar (UZ): Bolalar maktabda raqobatli sport bilan shug‘ullanishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, definitely. Participating in sports teaches young students essential values such as teamwork, mutual respect, dealing with defeat gracefully, and maintaining physical fitness.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, albatta. Sport bilan shug‘ullanish yosh o‘quvchilarga jamoada ishlash, o‘zaro hurmat, mag‘lubiyatni munosib qabul qilish va jismoniy sog‘lomlikni saqlash kabi muhim qadriyatlarni o‘rgatadi.

Sovollar: 3. What are the advantages of competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Raqobatli sportning qanday afzalliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: The primary advantages include improved cardiovascular health, reduced mental stress, heightened discipline, and the development of strong leadership and communication capabilities.
FullAnswer_UZ: Asosiy afzalliklar qatoriga yurak-qon tomir salomatligining yaxshilanishi, ruhiy stressning kamayishi, yuqori intizom hamda kuchli yetakchilik va muloqot qobiliyatlarining rivojlanishi kiradi.

Sovollar: 4. What are the disadvantages of competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Raqobatli sportning qanday kamchiliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: The main drawbacks are the risk of severe physical injuries, excessive psychological pressure to win at all costs, and potential conflicts between aggressive opponents.
FullAnswer_UZ: Asosiy kamchiliklar bu og‘ir jismoniy jarohatlar xavfi, har qanday yo‘l bilan g‘alaba qozonish uchun ortiqcha psixologik bosim va raqiblar o‘rtasidagi yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan agressiv nizolardir.

Sovollar: 1. What do you do in your free time?
Sovollar (UZ): Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: In my leisure time, I enjoy reading insightful books, practicing spoken English, going for refreshing outdoor walks, and exploring new technology trends on the internet.
FullAnswer_UZ: Bo‘sh vaqtimda men mazmunli kitoblarni o‘qishni, ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvni mashq qilishni, ochiq havoda sayr qilishni va internetda yangi texnologiya tendensiyalarini o‘rganishni yoqtiraman.

Sovollar: 2. Have you ever participated in any sport competitions?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz hech sport musobaqalarida qatnashganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I have competed in local football tournaments and sprint running events at school, which proved to be an exhilarating and character-building experience.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men maktabda mahalliy futbol turnirlarida va qisqa masofaga yugurish musobaqalarida qatnashganman, bu juda hayajonli va xarakterni shakllantiruvchi tajriba bo‘lgan.

Sovollar: 3. Do you like travelling across your country?
Sovollar (UZ): O‘z mamlakatingiz bo‘ylab sayohat qilishni yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, absolutely. Uzbekistan has a rich historical heritage, and I truly love exploring legendary ancient cities such as Samarkand, Bukhara, and Khiva.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, albatta. O‘zbekiston boy tarixiy merosga ega va men Samarqand, Buxoro va Xiva kabi afsonaviy qadimiy shaharlarni ziyorat qilishni va o‘rganishni juda yaxshi ko‘raman.

Sovollar: 4. Do you prefer to spend time indoors or outdoors?
Sovollar (UZ): Vaqtingizni bino ichida o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘rasizmi yoki ochiq havoda?
FullAnswer_EN: I prefer spending time outdoors because fresh air and scenic natural surroundings help relieve mental fatigue and keep me physically energized.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men vaqtimni ochiq havoda o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘raman, chunki toza havo va chiroyli tabiiy manzara aqliy charchoqni ketkazishga va jismonan baquvvat bo‘lishimga yordam beradi.

Sovollar: 1. Describe your dream job.
Sovollar (UZ): Orzuingizdagi kasbni tasvirlab bering.
FullAnswer_EN: My dream job is to work as an international software engineer or data analyst at a world-class tech company, where I can build impactful digital products and work flexibly from anywhere in the world.
FullAnswer_UZ: Mening orzuyimdagi kasbim — jahon darajasidagi texnologiya kompaniyasida xalqaro dasturiy ta’minot muhandisi yoki ma’lumotlar tahlilchisi bo‘lib ishlashdir, u yerda men foydali raqamli mahsulotlar yaratishim va dunyoning istalgan nuqtasidan erkin ishlay olishim mumkin.

Sovollar: 2. What job will be popular in the future?
Sovollar (UZ): Kelajakda qaysi kasb ommabop bo‘ladi?
FullAnswer_EN: Professions related to Artificial Intelligence, cybersecurity, renewable green energy engineering, and digital healthcare will be in exceptionally high demand in the coming decades.
FullAnswer_UZ: Kelgusi o‘n yilliklarda Sun’iy Intellekt, kiberxavfsizlik, qayta tiklanuvchi yashil energiya muhandisligi va raqamli sog‘liqni saqlash bilan bog‘liq kasblarga talab favqulodda yuqori bo‘ladi.

Sovollar: 3. Explain profession that is getting popular in your country now.
Sovollar (UZ): Hozir mamlakatingizda ommalashib borayotgan kasbni tushuntiring.
FullAnswer_EN: Information Technology and digital programming are rapidly booming in Uzbekistan today because the government is actively supporting modern IT parks and creating tremendous high-paying opportunities for young specialists.
FullAnswer_UZ: Bugungi kunda O‘zbekistonda Axborot Texnologiyalari va raqamli dasturlash jadal rivojlanmoqda, chunki davlat zamonaviy IT-parklarni faol qo‘llab-quvvatlamoqda va yosh mutaxassislar uchun juda ko‘p yuqori maoshli imkoniyatlar yaratmoqda.

Sovollar: 4. How will technology help people to do business that is more successful?
Sovollar (UZ): Texnologiya odamlarga biznesni yanada muvaffaqiyatli qilishda qanday yordam beradi?
FullAnswer_EN: Technology enables businesses to automate repetitive operations, analyze complex customer data, deliver rapid worldwide delivery, and reach millions of potential clients through international e-commerce channels.
FullAnswer_UZ: Texnologiya bizneslarga takrorlanuvchi jarayonlarni avtomatlashtirish, mijozlarning murakkab ma’lumotlarini tahlil qilish, tezkor xalqaro yetkazib berishni ta’minlash va xalqaro elektron tijorat kanallari orqali millionlab potensial mijozlarga yetib borish imkonini beradi.

Sovollar (UZ): Sizning shahringizda yashash xavfsizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, my city is exceptionally safe. The streets are well-lit at night, police patrols are active, and violent crime rates are remarkably low compared to many global capitals.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, mening shahrim favqulodda xavfsiz. Kechasi ko‘chalar yaxshi yoritilgan, politsiya patrullari faol ishlaydi va zo‘ravonlik bilan bog‘liq jinoyatlar darajasi ko‘plab jahon poytaxtlariga qaraganda ancha past.

Sovollar: 2. What types of crimes do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qanday jinoyat turlarini bilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I am aware of various crimes, including petty theft, burglary, and vandalism, as well as modern digital offences like internet fraud, identity theft, and hacking.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men mayda o‘g‘rilik, xonadonga bostirib kirish va mulkni buzish kabi jinoyatlar bilan bir qatorda internet firibgarligi, shaxsiy ma’lumotlarni o‘g‘irlash va xakerlik kabi zamonaviy raqamli jinoyatlarni ham bilaman.

Sovollar: 3. Is the nightlife dangerous in your city?
Sovollar (UZ): Shahringizda tungi hayot xavflimi?
FullAnswer_EN: No, it is generally very peaceful and secure. People of all ages can comfortably stroll in public parks, dine at late-night cafes, and use reliable public transport without fearing for their safety.
FullAnswer_UZ: Yo‘q, u umuman olganda juda tinch va xavfsiz. Barcha yoshdagi insonlar jamoat bog‘larida bemalol sayr qilishlari, tungi kafelarda ovqatlanishlari va o‘z xavfsizliklaridan qo‘rqmasdan ishonchli jamoat transportidan foydalanishlari mumkin.

Sovollar: 4. Have you ever witnessed any type of crime?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz hech qanday jinoyatning guvohi bo‘lganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Fortunately, I have never witnessed any violent crimes in person, although I have occasionally heard about minor pickpocketing incidents on crowded public buses.
FullAnswer_UZ: Baxtimga, men shaxsan hech qachon jiddiy zo‘ravonlik jinoyatining guvohi bo‘lmaganman, garchi gavjum jamoat avtobuslarida mayda cho‘ntakkesarlik holatlari haqida ba’zan eshitgan bo‘lsam-da.

Sovollar: 1. What would you do to decrease the crime rate if you worked as a police officer?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar politsiya xodimi bo‘lib ishlasangiz, jinoyatchilik darajasini kamaytirish uchun nima qilgan bo‘lardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: If I were a police officer, I would install comprehensive modern surveillance cameras, increase community patrols in vulnerable neighborhoods, and organize youth awareness campaigns about legal consequences.
FullAnswer_UZ: Agar men politsiya xodimi bo‘lganimda, zamonaviy kuzatuv kameralarini o‘rnatgan, xavfli mahallalarda jamoat patrullarini ko‘paytirgan va yoshlar o‘rtasida qonuniy oqibatlar haqida tushuntirish kampaniyalarini tashkil qilgan bo‘lardim.

Sovollar: 2. Why do you think crime rates are higher in cities?
Sovollar (UZ): Nega shaharlarda jinoyatchilik darajasi yuqoriroq deb o‘ylaysiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Cities experience higher crime rates due to high population density, economic inequalities, social anonymity, and greater opportunities for illegal financial gains.
FullAnswer_UZ: Shaharlarda jinoyatchilik darajasining yuqoriligi aholi zichligining kattaligi, iqtisodiy tengsizlik, insonlarning bir-birini tanimasligi (anonimlik) va noqonuniy moliyaviy daromad olish imkoniyatlarining ko‘pligi bilan bog‘liq.

Sovollar: 3. What is cybercrime?
Sovollar (UZ): Kiberjinoyat nima?
FullAnswer_EN: Cybercrime refers to illegal activities conducted via computers and the internet, such as unauthorized data hacking, phishing scams, credit card fraud, and distributing malicious software.
FullAnswer_UZ: Kiberjinoyat — bu kompyuterlar va internet orqali amalga oshiriladigan noqonuniy harakatlar, masalan, ruxsatsiz ma’lumotlarni buzib kirish (xakerlik), fishing firibgarligi, kredit karta o‘g‘riligi va zararli virus dasturlarini tarqatishdir.

Sovollar: 4. Would you help a person if he/she were being attacked??
Sovollar (UZ): Agar kimdir hujumga uchragan bo‘lsa, siz unga yordam berarmidingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I would definitely help, but in a smart and secure way. I would immediately call the emergency police hotline and attract the attention of nearby people to intervene safely without risking lives unnecessarily.

Sovollar: 2. Do you prefer watching movies at home or in the cinema? Why?
Sovollar (UZ): Filmlarni uyda ko‘rishni afzal ko‘rasizmi yoki kinoteatrdami? Nega?
FullAnswer_EN: I prefer watching films in the cinema because the colossal screen, surround sound systems, and collective audience atmosphere deliver an unmatched immersive cinematic experience.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men kinolarni kinoteatrda ko‘rishni afzal ko‘raman, chunki ulkan ekran, ajoyib ovoz tizimlari va tomoshabinlarning umumiy muhiti tengsiz va ta’sirchan kino tajribasini taqdim etadi.

FullAnswer_UZ: Mening sevimli filmim — Kristofer Nolan tomonidan suratga olingan 'Interstellar' filmi, chunki unda chuqur ilmiy mavzular, ajoyib vizual effektlar, ota va qiz o‘rtasidagi ta’sirchan rishta va aqlbovar qilmas musiqa mujassamlashgan.

FullAnswer_EN: My favorite actor is Leonardo DiCaprio because of his extraordinary versatility, charismatic screen presence, and masterclass performances in legendary films like 'Inception' and 'The Revenant'.
FullAnswer_UZ: Mening sevimli aktyorim — Leonardo Di Kaprio, chunki u favqulodda ko‘p qirrali mahoratga, jozibador ko‘rinishga va 'Inception' hamda 'The Revenant' kabi afsonaviy filmlarda yuksak darajadagi ijroga ega.

Sovollar: 1. Do you play video games?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz video o‘yinlar o‘ynaysizmi?
